Rain causes ceiling leak at Microsoft conference, flooding Meta stall

Heavy rain in San Francisco caused a ceiling leak at the Microsoft Ignite conference, leading to disruptions and flooding the Meta stall. The incident was part of wider weather-related disruptions across the region.
